extensionDescription.message: Let LinkSense operate authorized Chrome/Edge pages using your existing login sessions.

consent.message: Connect only to a LinkSense you trust. Authorized page content and screenshots can be sent to LinkSense and its configured model. Connecting replaces your previous browser connection.

failed.message: Could not complete this action. Check the connection and try again.

confirmHint.message: Approve this site once. Future connections are automatic.

disconnectedHint.message: Connects when you open LinkSense and sign in.

newTabsHint.message: Let the assistant open a page when a task needs it.

pageHint.message: Share this page so the assistant can read and interact with it.

sharedHint.message: The assistant can use this page. Stop sharing at any time.

restrictedPage.message: Switch to a webpage to share it. LinkSense and browser pages cannot be shared.
